Using the three-trillion-parameter open-source Kimi K3 model as an example, the company explains how model layers are distributed across multiple wafers to achieve high throughput.

entry.content:

Micron Technology workers at the company's Taoyuan facility in Taiwan initiated the semiconductor industry's first-ever strike in the region following a breakdown in negotiations over employee bonuses. The labor union is demanding a permanent profit-sharing system equivalent to 15% of operating profits to better reflect record earnings driven by the artificial intelligence memory boom.

The labor dispute highlights tensions between memory chipmakers enjoying massive windfalls from AI demand and the workforce pushing for larger compensation packages. Representatives from the union and management have remained at odds despite previous bonus announcements, as the strike threatens to impact critical manufacturing hubs within the global AI supply chain.
